styl:
.iq-combo-assets-orange--middle-title
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  font-weight: 700
  font-size: 32px
  line-height: 42px
  color: #393A44
  vertical-align: middle
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    font-size 28px !important
    line-height 34px !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--white-bg
  background-color: #ffffff
.iq-combo-assets-orange--brad-full
  border-radius 32px !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--text-pad-small
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    padding-left: 20px !important
    padding-right: 20px !important
ul
  margin 0
  padding 0 0 0 20px
.iq-combo-assets-orange--orange-block
  background url('https://fsms.quadcode.com/storage/public/d6/o2/ua3ursrq72d917s0/bcg.png') center no-repeat
  background-size cover
  background-color #FFF8F0
  border-radius: 24px
.iq-combo-assets-orange--w40
  float none
  display inline-block
  width 210px
  vertical-align: bottom
  padding 24px 0 24px 32px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    float none !important
    display block !important
    margin 0 auto !important
    width auto !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--right-img
  float none
  display inline-block
  width 214px !important
  vertical-align: bottom
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    float none !important
    display block !important
    margin 0 auto !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--text
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  font-size: 18px
  color: #393A44
  letter-spacing: 0
  line-height: 26px
  font-weight 400
.iq-combo-assets-orange--asset-block
  display inline-block
  border: 1px solid #ECECED
  border-radius: 24px
  width 222px
  margin-bottom 16px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    display block !important
    margin 0 auto 16px !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--pd20
  padding: 20px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    padding 20px !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--asset
  font-family: Helvetica !important
  font-style: normal
  font-weight: 700
  font-size: 18px
  line-height: 27px
  color: #393A44
.iq-combo-assets-orange--asset-logo-top
  display inline-block
  width 40px !important
  float none
  vertical-align: middle
.iq-combo-assets-orange--m-w-2
  min-width: 48px !important
  width 48px !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--mr16
  margin-right 14px
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px)
    margin-right 0 !important
.iq-combo-assets-orange--w100
  width 100%
.iq-combo-assets-orange--w-a
  width auto !important
  vertical-align: middle
